workflowNarrative:
The Trip Lead is the entry point and fixes the shape first: dates, travellers, budget, and pace. Everything else is detail, and detail decided before the shape decides the shape by accident.

The Route Planner and the Local Scout then work in parallel. The planner works out getting there and getting around door to door, including the transfers nobody photographs and the connections that cannot be missed. The scout gathers two or three options per day and, more usefully, marks which ones stop being possible if nobody decides this week.

The Packing Steward runs last, once the shape is fixed, building the document list first and checking every expiry against the return date rather than the departure date. The desk books nothing and pays for nothing, and it re-runs a week before departure because everything changes.
